title: pinalia sulcata
intro: Pinalia sulcata, commonly known as the Chinese pinesap orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pinalia sulcata include vasodilatation and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pinalia sulcata include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
